summary: scripts/ was outside both socket-importer ratchets and a script has no app kill switch, socket guard or robots read. A third ratchet lists the 17 scripts that import a socket-capable library, each with a reason read from its code (13 egress, maintainer-run or CI; 4 loopback or none), and fails on a new one until it is listed and named in docs/SECURITY.md, whose new paragraph says what each reaches. User-run scripts (stat_news_check, thesaurus_build, build_place_gazetteer) take the guarded path behind --online.
